basic_info.description: Big, bright and sunny NOPA top floor flat in a 2-unit building (condo). Grand scale rooms with tall windows, tall ceilings and amazing natural light. Large backyard. Wide and deep lot 27x137 = 3763ft (per tax records). 1923 Edwardian period details (wood floors, Juliette balcony, coved ceilings, decorative fireplace) with modern updates.     Living room is south facing with floor to ceiling windows and spans the length of the building. Dining room is off the kitchen and opens directly to an updated kitchen with a large lightwell and 3 big windows for more natural light. 2 bedroom + sunroom. Split bath. Laundry room with w/d. Potential for 2nd bathroom addition.     Independent parking for 1 car. Storage. Walk to GG Park. . Walk to Whole Foods, Flywheel coffee, GG Park, and Divisadero and Haight restaurants, bars and cafes.
